posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
After the latest episode of the Letters Page as per this typing(Iron Legacy and Alternate Realities/Timelines), my interest in the Animal-verse is at it's max. I now want to make a more 'cannon' Animal-themed reality that my players will be able to visit in my rpg campaign, but I am nowhere near 'punny' enough to come up with propper names. So, I'm asking for any and all suggestions from here on the forums!

Some rules I'll set down:

Try and stick to Disney/Zootopia rules, meaning mostly mammals.

Some birds and reptiles will be fine though.

No fish.

Some particulars I'd really like:

Legacy's gotta be a dog, meaning Baron Blade has to be a cat of some kind. :P

I'm probably gonna use the Cat-tralist for this universe. His weird hairless ape form is too funny not to use.

Thank you in advance for your help!
